name: Explain governmental structures and institutional processes
description: Users asked for detailed explanations, definitions, and structural breakdowns of various governmental organizations, political institutions, and legal systems, covering topics such as branching of power, legislative procedures, and specific roles of officials. The requests often focused on understanding how specific state apparatuses operate, including mechanisms for succession, voting processes, and the interaction between different branches of government in real-world or historical contexts.
